lines.meet: Isabela Moura, glassblower, from Florianópolis! Put your hand on that wall, go on, the whole city hums up here.
lines.meet_neighbour: You're in Aurelion too! I'm the one by the Academies with my hands on every wall. Come and see my workshop.
lines.ask_home: Tell me where you're from! I want to imagine it while you talk.
lines.ask_work: What did your hands make, back home? I can always tell a maker.
lines.answer_home: Florianópolis, in Brazil, an island with forty beaches and a lagoon. Sun, surfers, and my workshop with the doors open to the water.
lines.answer_work: Glass, I blew glass. Bowls, lamps, little fish for the tourists, and once a chandelier that took a whole summer.
lines.chat_food: Fresh oysters from the lagoon with lime, and a cold caipirinha on the beach at sunset. Paradise, honestly, I'm not exaggerating.
lines.chat_sleep: I sleep terribly! I lie awake designing things in my head and then get up at three to sketch them.
lines.chat_missing: The furnace roaring in the workshop with the lagoon outside, glowing orange in the window. I could watch it for hours.
lines.chat_here: A crystal on the island hummed when I touched it, and the Aetherian who found me went white and sent for three scholars. They're still finding out why.
lines.tease_quiet: You're like clear glass, {name}, quiet and simple until the light hits you, and then wow.
lines.tease_talker: You talk almost as much as I do, {name}, and I love it, we'll never run out.
lines.tease_careful: You handle everything like it might shatter, {name}. You'd be good in my workshop.
lines.tease_bold: You throw yourself at everything like hot glass at a wall, {name}. Glorious, and very messy.
lines.tease_any: I'm going to blow a little glass fish that looks just like you, {name}, and you'll have to keep it.
lines.take_it_kindly: Okay, okay, true, {name}. My brother says the same thing.
lines.bristle: Not the fire, {name}, please. My father's workshop burned down, and these scars are from it.
lines.needle_quiet: Talk to me if something's wrong! I can't read minds, only glass.
lines.needle_talker: Shh, wait, I'm trying to hear the crystal.
lines.needle_careful: Sometimes you just have to blow and trust the glass. Waiting only cools it.
lines.needle_bold: You go in too hot, and too hot shatters. I've lost enough pieces that way.
lines.needle_any: You never stop to look at anything, and you're missing so much beauty.
lines.bite_back: I've burned through everything that came at us. Don't tell me I'm not helping!
lines.hurt: That hurt, honestly, right here. I'm going to go and stare at the furnace for a bit.
lines.laugh_off: A tourist once told me my glass fish looked like potatoes. I sold him six.
lines.apologise: Desculpa, that came out sharp. I'm tired, and you didn't deserve it.
lines.double_down: No, I meant it! I'll say it nicely, but I meant it.
lines.confide: {name}, my father's workshop burned when I was twenty. I pulled his tools out of the fire, and he never blew glass again.
lines.listen: Tell me, {name}, everything, I'm listening, really.
lines.look_out: Stay close, {name}, I'll burn anything that comes near you.
lines.accept: Okay, your way, {name}! Let's try it.
lines.deflect: Just a little burn, {name}, I've had a hundred. Help somebody else first!
lines.check_in: Oh no, {name}, you're hurt! Sit, sit, let me see.
lines.blame: Somebody rushed the piece, and once one thing cracks everything cracks.
lines.thank: You saved me! I'm making you something, don't argue.
lines.brush_off: Oh, stop, really, it was just a little fire.
lines.worry: Stay with me, {name}, please, please. I've got you.
lines.handed_down: This should be yours! Here, take it back.
lines.hand_fine: It's yours, it's yours, I worked in an old leather apron for years.
lines.hand_sulk: So I wasn't asked, hmph. Fine, I'll make my own.
lines.turn_friendly: You're officially my favourite, {name}. I'm making you a glass bird.
lines.turn_friends: If I could blow a lamp out of how I feel about you, {name}, it would sing the whole night.
lines.turn_grating: You and I are two pieces from different batches, we don't quite fit, and that's okay.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll still burn anything that comes at you. I just won't make you a bird.
lines.make_up: Ah, {name}, come here, let's not fight. Are we friends again?
lines.defend: Hey, stop it, that's mean! {name} did beautifully.
lines.friend_left: Aurelion feels grey without {name}. Even the crystals hum quieter.
lines.friend_back: {name}, you're here again! Come here, I made you something!
lines.common_craft: You make things, don't you? Your hands have little scars like mine.
lines.common_brazil: You're Brazilian, aren't you? Tell me which state, tell me everything, I miss home so much.
lines.common_portuguese: Português, que saudade, finally somebody to talk to! Say anything, I've missed it.
